meta.title: Voyager Wayfinder demo
meta.description: A small plumbing business site with services, service areas, a synced pattern and a menu, opened on the Wayfinder page.
meta.author: voyager-marketing

steps.data:
<?php
// A clone of the repository has no vendor/: each release builds Composer's
// autoloader. This one loads the same PSR-4 map: the Voyager\Wayfinder namespace from src/.
spl_autoload_register(static function (string $class): void {
    $prefix = 'Voyager\\Wayfinder\\';
    if (!str_starts_with($class, $prefix)) {
        return;
    }
    $file = dirname(__DIR__) . '/src/' . str_replace('\\', '/', substr($class, strlen($prefix))) . '.php';
    if (is_file($file)) {
        require $file;
    }
});

<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: Riverbend Plumbing demo
 * Description: Content model for the Voyager Wayfinder demo site.
 */

add_action('init', static function (): void {
    register_post_type('service', [
        'labels' => ['name' => 'Services', 'singular_name' => 'Service'],
        'public' => true,
        'has_archive' => true,
        'rewrite' => ['slug' => 'services'],
        'supports' => ['title', 'editor', 'excerpt', 'custom-fields'],
        'show_in_rest' => true,
        'menu_icon' => 'dashicons-hammer',
    ]);
    register_post_meta('service', 'price_from', ['type' => 'number', 'label' => 'Price from', 'single' => true, 'show_in_rest' => true]);
    register_post_meta('service', 'duration', ['type' => 'string', 'label' => 'Duration', 'single' => true, 'show_in_rest' => true]);
    register_taxonomy('service_area', ['service'], [
        'labels' => ['name' => 'Service areas', 'singular_name' => 'Service area'],
        'public' => true,
        'show_in_rest' => true,
        'show_admin_column' => true,
    ]);
});
